constituent_elements.gloss: be across in a vertical position

etymology.raw_etymology: <perh. wi+ruu, upright + PORT; cf. pira- raking; scraping>

examples.english_translation: move, move aside; move in a sweeping manner; ref. to a heavy object.
scrape snow off, as when cleaning a path; sweep snow off.

glosses.definition: brush, sweep, rake this way; move, push this way (with a brushing movement), as with one's hand, a broom, or rake.
rake, smooth by raking, level by a raking movement, as when raking leaves.

etymology.raw_etymology: <wiruu+a (ir...), sweep this way, i.e., come sweeping>

glosses.definition: sweep, brush, rake aside, as with one's hand, a broom, or rake; move, move over or back, push aside with a sweeping or brushing movement
persuade, convince, induce, coax, talk into doing, as a course of action, a metaphor for sweeping aside (objections, concerns); motivate.

etymology.raw_etymology: <wiruu+at, sweep that way, i.e., go sweeping>

glosses.definition: sweep, brush, rake aside, over, or back
glosses.usage_notes: as with one's hand, a broom, or rake; move, move over, move back, push aside, push back with a sweeping or brushing movement, as a pile of trash

glosses.definition: be determined, as to have one's own way; stand one's ground.
